name: application-track-list-row
title: Track List Row
description: Music track list where each row shows its index (swapping to a play icon on hover), title, artist, and duration, with a highlighted currently-playing row.
useWhen: Displaying an album or playlist track listing where users click a row to start playback.
You want the track number to double as a play-on-hover affordance without adding a separate button column.
The currently playing track needs a distinct, persistent highlight, not just a hover state.
avoidWhen: You need drag-to-reorder or multi-select — extend this pattern with your own selection/reorder logic; it's a display list on its own.
The rows represent generic media rather than playable tracks — use media-object-row for a non-playback context.
You need album art thumbnails per row — extend the row with a leading image slot rather than replacing this pattern.
responsiveBehavior: The list is a fixed max-w-md block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: The playing row uses both color and a distinct 'now playing' bars icon in place of the track number, not color alone.
Track title and artist are always plain, selectable text, keeping the list readable and copyable by assistive tech.
Duration is right-aligned in a monospace font so times stay visually scannable down the column.

variants.title: Track list row
variants.description: Four-track list with the second track highlighted as currently playing (bars icon, blue text) and hover-revealed play icons on the others.
accessibility: Each row is a clickable list item; wire keyboard activation (Enter/Space) alongside the click handler in your own integration.

variants.title: Track list row (Dark)
variants.description: Track list row adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Playing-state highlight and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
